title: Culture beyond recognition – SOTEU 2026
content:
Ahead of the State of the Union address taking place 16 September 2026, Culture Action Europe sent a letter to European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen on 27 August 2026. The letter calls on the European Commission to match the political recognition given to culture in the Culture Compass and signed Joint Declaration with clear political action. The letter is shared in full below, and you can learn more about our Ask, Pay, Trust campaign here.

Dear President von der Leyen,

Last year, we wrote to you ahead of the State of the Union because culture was missing. This year, we are writing for a different reason: culture is finally present.

On 18 June, you joined the Presidents of the European Parliament and the Council in signing the Joint Declaration ‘Europe for Culture—Culture for Europe.’ For the first time in the history of the EU, three institutions came together around a shared political commitment to culture.
